# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech to Build Something](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): Personal reflections on quitting a stable tech job to pursue entrepreneurship and self-directed projects.

## Other

- [Claude Surf AI Orchestrator](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): AI-powered tool orchestrating autonomous software development with Claude, integrating Linear tickets and Git workflows.
- [Color Theory Fundamentals](https://www.justinhe.com/a): Practice note on color theory principles including wheels, harmony schemes, and perceptual color spaces.
- [Martian Ideas Through History](https://www.justinhe.com/b): Two centuries of human imagination about Martians, from canals to invasion novels to actual spacecraft discoveries.
- [The Shipping Container's Impact](https://www.justinhe.com/c): How standardized steel containers revolutionized global trade, displaced dock workers, and enabled modern globalization economics.
- [Sourdough Science and Practice](https://www.justinhe.com/d): Detailed exploration of sourdough starter microbiology, fermentation chemistry, and baking techniques.
- [Ancient Eclipse Predicting Device](https://www.justinhe.com/e): Ancient bronze gearwork calculator from 150-100 BCE that predicted eclipses and tracked lunar cycles.
- [Songbird Vocal Learning Neuroscience](https://www.justinhe.com/f): How songbirds learn to sing through sensory and sensorimotor phases, critical periods, auditory feedback, and neural circuits.
- [Map Projections Explained](https://www.justinhe.com/g): Why every flat map distorts Earth, what projections preserve, and Web Mercator's dominance.
- [Bioluminescence Chemistry and Biology](https://www.justinhe.com/h): Explores the chemistry of cold light, evolutionary adaptations, and biological applications of bioluminescence in marine life.
- [Pokémon's Origins and Development](https://www.justinhe.com/x): How Satoshi Tajiri's childhood bug collecting in suburban Tokyo inspired the creation of Pokémon through Game Freak magazine and six years of challenging development.
- [Competitive Pokémon Metagame](https://www.justinhe.com/y): How players built competitive Pokémon's ruleset through datamining hidden mechanics and community standards.
- [Pokémon Red Blue Generation One Glitches](https://www.justinhe.com/z): Exploration of famous bugs that shaped Pokémon Gen 1 including MissingNo and Mew glitch.
